meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把回复变成先给下一步、步骤编号、带时间估计的清爽格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果长回复总让你走神,希望每条建议都能立刻动手。
copy.tagline_en: Turn replies into numbered next steps with clear time estimates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long answers lose you and you want a clear next step every time.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 的回复会先给出下一步可做的动作,多步任务改成编号列表,每轮重述当前进度,给具体时间估计,压掉跑题内容,并明确写出已经完成的部分。
howto.when: 默认对任何一条消息都生效,包括写代码、调试、解释等,即使你没要求简洁也一样;用 /i-have-adhd 开启,说 “stop adhd mode” 关闭。

say.note: 开启后回复先给下一步动作

say.text: 这个测试挂了,帮我看下

howto.what_en: Once on, Claude leads with the next action, numbers multi-step work, restates state each turn, gives concrete time estimates, drops tangents, and surfaces what is done. Start with /i-have-adhd.
howto.when_en: Applies to every reply, including coding, debugging, and explanations, even when you did not ask for brevity. Turn it on with /i-have-adhd; say "stop adhd mode" to turn it off.

say_en.text: This test is failing, help me fix it
